Per the assignment, any next Linux proof or diagnosis of the repaired head (the Windows findings job reports a partial repair pushed at 2ea7f584f0ca91a9de470ebe72b4063e8685de02) must use a new job; this reconciliation ran no Gradle task and mutated no source.
